summary: Track obligations to counterparties as debts with a currency, the account they reserve money on and an optional project; debts can be settled and cancelled from their drawer, and the overview, debts and accounts pages show money on accounts, reserved by open obligations and available per currency. Adds a migration, services.BalanceService and the services.ProjectDirectory port provided by the projects module; NewDebtService, NewDebtsController, NewFinancialOverviewController and the debt drawer props change signature.
